message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is usually **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During the brief overlap when Europe is still on daylight‑saving time but the U.S. has already switched back to standard time (last Sunday in October through first Sunday in November), the gap widens to **10 hours**.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?" They want the time difference. We need to provide the answer. There's no mention of a specific date. Time difference can vary due to daylight saving changes. We should explain that Los Angeles is in Pacific Time (PT) and Berlin is in Central European Time (CET). Usually, the difference is 9 hours (Berlin ahead). But during daylight saving, Los Angeles is PDT (UTC-7) and Berlin is CEST (UTC+2), so still 9 hours. Actually, both observe DST but offset remains 9 hours. However, there might be a period when one is on DST and the other not. Let's check: In the US, DST starts second Sunday in March and ends first Sunday in November. In Europe, DST starts last Sunday in March and ends last Sunday in October. So there's a period from March to early March? Let's compute: In early March, before second Sunday, US is on standard time (UTC-8), Europe is on standard time (UTC+1). So difference is 9 hours. After second Sunday in March, US moves to DST (UTC-7), Europe moves to DST on last Sunday in March (UTC+2). So difference remains 9 hours. But after last Sunday in March, Europe is on DST (UTC+2), US is on DST (UTC-7). So difference remains 9 hours. After last Sunday in March until first Sunday in November, difference remains 9 hours. After first Sunday in November, US moves back to standard time (UTC-8), Europe remains on DST until last Sunday in October. So between last Sunday in October and first Sunday in November, Europe is on DST (UTC+2), US is on standard time (UTC-8). So difference is 10 hours. So there is a period where difference is 10 hours. That period is from last Sunday in October until first Sunday in November. So we should mention that normally it's 9 hours, but during that period it's 10 hours.
